data: Tesla reported diluted earnings per share of $4.30 for fiscal 2023, up from $3.62 in fiscal 2022, an increase of $0.68 or about 18.8%. Net income for fiscal 2023 was $14,974 million (about $15.0 billion), compared with $12,587 million in fiscal 2022. Net income attributable to common stockholders was $14,997 million in 2023. The 2023 figure was boosted by a $5,001 million income tax benefit, which more than offset a drop in income from operations from $13,656 million to $8,891 million.
